title: krn adopt --init yields a born-green ts, php and python project with zero audit FAIL
body: Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115c.md slice 4. Outcome: adopt --init for ts/php/python gives CI, linter, README test command, lockfile, gitignore, strict tsconfig, instruction file and tracker; audit 0 FAIL on every applicable record. Proof: three empty-directory tests + audit table (measure current FAIL first). Free. src/adopt/init.ts.
